senses: A king of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.12.21;
a king of Judah, son Joash, father of Azariah
a priest of Bethel under Jeroboam II
father of Joshah, of the tribe of Simeon
a Levite tabernacle singer in David's day

strongs.def: Amatsjah, the name of four Israelites
strongs.from: or אֲמַצְיָהוּ; from H553 (אָמַץ) and H3050 (יָהּ); strength of Jah
